title: Reviewer failure classification and verdict propagation
summary: A reviewer's raw output is untrusted text that can hold a credential, so this change stops it from reaching osf's output, journal, SARIF or posted review. A new harness-independent classifier (crates/osf/src/failure.rs) reads stdout and stderr — JSON status/label fields first, plain-text patterns last — and returns only a fixed Category whose wording osf owns; exit and timeout reasons now carry that category plus exit code and elapsed seconds. On top of that, a reviewer job that made attempts and never answered writes its --out file, then exits 2, and the posted verdict follows the run's overall verdict: a run that could not run posts COMMENT and never APPROVE, a failed run requests changes. Kept reviewer homes are chmodded readable (0755/0644) after the seeded login is removed, and each workflow job uploads only out/reviewer-home/osf-review-home-*.

nodes.label: review.yml
nodes.subtitle: reviewer jobs + quorum job
nodes.summary: Three reviewer jobs (codex, claude, opencode) and a final review job. Each reviewer job uploads only out/reviewer-home/osf-review-home-* and may fail; the final job runs with always() and decides by quorum rather than by a reviewer job's result.

nodes.label: reviewer job
nodes.subtitle: osf review run --reviewer
nodes.summary: Runs one reviewer, then uploads its kept home and its --out file. It no longer passes --warn-only, so a reviewer that tried and never answered turns the job red after the artifacts are written.

nodes.label: review job
nodes.subtitle: always() && quorum
nodes.summary: The last job runs even after a red reviewer job and decides by quorum, not by needs.review-* results.

nodes.label: review run
nodes.subtitle: review_run_exit_code
nodes.summary: Saves the reviewer run first, then returns 0 when something answered and 2 when the reviewer made attempts and none answered, so the artifact explains the red job.

nodes.label: post run outcome
nodes.subtitle: post_run_outcome
nodes.summary: Posts the run's findings and summary, now passing the run's overall verdict into plan_review_for so the posted event follows it.

nodes.label: plan_review_for
nodes.subtitle: findings + overall verdict -> Plan
nodes.summary: Chooses the posted verdict: a blocking finding requests changes whatever the run said, a failed run requests changes, a run that could not run posts COMMENT, and a pass or no overall verdict approves.

nodes.label: Verdict
nodes.subtitle: RequestChanges | Approve | Comment
nodes.summary: Gains Comment, a review with no verdict to give that is never an approval, and maps it to the COMMENT event.

nodes.label: never_answered
nodes.subtitle: ReviewerRun::never_answered
nodes.summary: True when a reviewer made at least one attempt or could not build a lens's context and no attempt on any lens answered. An idle reviewer that tried nothing has not failed.

nodes.label: run_child
nodes.subtitle: spawn, capture, classify
nodes.summary: Spawns the reviewer, drains stdout and stderr, and on timeout or non-zero exit builds a reason from the failure category plus exit code and elapsed seconds, never from the reviewer's text.

nodes.label: failure::classify
nodes.subtitle: stdout + stderr -> Category
nodes.summary: Harness-independent reader: JSON fields (statusCode, status, api_error_status, error.type, error.code, code) first, plain-text patterns last, returning one of eight fixed categories whose wording osf owns.

nodes.label: RunHome
nodes.subtitle: temp home + Drop
nodes.summary: On drop with OSF_KEEP_REVIEW_HOME set, opens the kept home recursively (folders 0755, files 0644, symlinks untouched) after forget_login removed the seeded login, so another user can upload it.

nodes.label: answer schema
nodes.subtitle: schema_for
nodes.summary: Strips $schema and $id from the schema handed to a harness, because claude refuses a schema naming a meta-schema it cannot resolve; the file keeps them for editors.

nodes.label: reviewer harness
nodes.subtitle: codex / claude / opencode
nodes.summary: The agent command osf spawns. Its stdout and stderr are untrusted text that may hold a credential.

nodes.label: provider API
nodes.subtitle: HTTP 401/403/404/429, DNS
nodes.summary: The remote model endpoint whose status codes and error labels the classifier reads out of the harness output.

edges.label: save, then never_answered()
edges.summary: The file is written before the exit code is decided, so the artifact explains the red job.

edges.label: classify(stdout, stderr)
edges.summary: The only path from reviewer text to osf's output: the classifier returns a fixed category, never the text.

edges.label: Some(outcome.verdict)
edges.summary: The run's overall verdict now reaches the posted event, so a run that could not run posts COMMENT instead of APPROVE.

flows.title: A reviewer fails: category, not text
flows.summary: A reviewer command exits non-zero. osf reads its stdout and stderr only to pick a fixed category, writes the run file, and turns the job red without ever repeating the reviewer's words.
